svg.title: Honesty banner
svg.desc: The page is a CPU simulation. It is not physical Eurorack, not an FPGA benchmark, and not a universal optimum.
svg.text: What this release refuses to say
No universal optimum. No physical time travel. No unmeasured silicon speed.
Solomonoff's full mixture is uncomputable. The toy is finite.
A browser patch is still software on a CPU.
